Package com.handshakr.handshakr_prototype.handshake.dto

Record Class HandshakeDto

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.handshakr.handshakr_prototype.handshake.dto.HandshakeDto
public record HandshakeDto(String handshakeName, String encryptedDetails, Instant signedDate, Instant completedDate, HandshakeStatus handshakeStatus, String initiatorUsername, String acceptorUsername) extends Record
A Data Transfer Object (DTO) that represents a handshake. Used to transfer the necessary data of a handshake between layers of the application.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:

      Returns:
